reactants.name: diethyl 1-(diphenoxyphosphoryl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate
reactants.stereochemistry: No configured stereocentre; the ring C4 is CH2.

catalysts_and_additives.name: 2,7,10-trimethyl-9-(2,4,6-trimethylphenyl)acridinium perchlorate
catalysts_and_additives.identity: Acridinium N at position 10 bears methyl; ring positions 2 and 7 bear methyl; C9 bears mesityl; cation +1 and perchlorate −1. No substituents beyond these.
catalysts_and_additives.ground_state: Closed-shell supplied acridinium cation and perchlorate anion.

catalysts_and_additives.name: BINOL-derived cyclic O,O-thiophosphoric N-triflyl imide
catalysts_and_additives.identity: Both 2,2-prime oxygens of 1,1-prime-binaphthyl connect to the same P; P also has =S and –NH–S(=O)2–CF3. No BINOL 3,3-prime substituents.
catalysts_and_additives.stereochemistry: The supplied reagent has no assigned axial configuration; no enantioselectivity observation is supplied.

catalysts_and_additives.name: chloropyridinebis(dimethylglyoximato)cobalt(III), Co(dmgH)2Cl(py)
catalysts_and_additives.identity: Octahedral Co(III), two equatorial bidentate N,N-dimethylglyoximato monoanions (each CH3–C(=N–OH)–C(=N–O−)–CH3), trans axial Cl− and pyridine; each ligand contributes two oxime N donors. Two oxime protons total, with interligand O–H···O hydrogen bonding.

equatorial_ligands.binding: Both oxime nitrogen atoms of each ligand coordinate to Co.

coordination_definition.geometry: Two N,N-chelates in the equatorial plane; chloride and pyridine trans on the axial sites.
coordination_definition.protons: Two retained oxime protons total; interligand O-H...O hydrogen bonds.
coordination_definition.state_boundary: The coordination graph specifies the supplied complex.

catalysts_and_additives.name: 10-methyl-9-(2,4,6-trimethylphenyl)acridinium perchlorate
catalysts_and_additives.identity: N10-methyl, C9-mesityl acridinium; unlike PC2, no methyl substituents at positions 2 and 7.
catalysts_and_additives.use: Comparison experiments only; the standard settings use PC2.

irradiation.source: Kessil A160WE Tuna Blue, rated 40 W
irradiation.note: Reported power is the lamp nameplate rating. Absorbed photon flux is unreported.

products.name: ethyl diphenyl phosphate
products.role: Experimentally characterized product in both settings.
